title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 28
description: Ten questions on Acts 28: the island of Malta, the viper and the healings, and Paul's two years of preaching in Rome.

questions.text: What was the island called where they came ashore?
questions.explanation: When they had escaped, they learned that the island was called Malta.

answers.text: Crete
Malta
Cyprus
Sicily

questions.text: Why did the natives kindle a fire and receive them all?
questions.explanation: The natives showed them uncommon kindness and kindled a fire because of the present rain and because of the cold.

answers.text: Because it was a feast day
Because they wanted to cook a meal
Because they were afraid of the prisoners
Because of the rain and the cold

questions.text: What came out of the bundle of sticks and fastened on Paul's hand?
questions.explanation: When Paul laid a bundle of sticks on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

answers.text: A viper
A scorpion
A wild dog
A swarm of bees

questions.text: What did the natives say when they saw the creature hanging from Paul's hand?
questions.explanation: They said to one another that no doubt this man was a murderer, whom Justice had not allowed to live even though he had escaped the sea.

answers.text: That he was a prophet of the sea
That he had stolen from the ship
That he was no doubt a murderer
That he should be thrown back into the sea

questions.text: What did the natives say about Paul after nothing bad happened to him?
questions.explanation: They had expected him to swell up or fall down dead, but when nothing bad happened they changed their minds and said he was a god.

answers.text: That he was a physician
That he was innocent of all charges
That the creature had not bitten him
That he was a god

questions.text: Who was the chief man of the island, who received them and entertained them for three days?
questions.explanation: Lands in the neighborhood belonged to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received them and courteously entertained them for three days.

answers.text: Julius
Publius
Aristarchus
Festus

questions.text: What was the sign of the ship of Alexandria in which they set sail after three months?
questions.explanation: After three months they set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose sign was "The Twin Brothers."

answers.text: "The Castor of Malta"
"The Three Taverns"
"The Twin Brothers"
"The Augustan Band"

questions.text: How far did the brothers come to meet them on the way to Rome?
questions.explanation: The brothers came to meet them as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns, and when Paul saw them he thanked God and took courage.

answers.text: As far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns
As far as the harbor at Rhegium
As far as Syracuse on the way from Malta
As far as the gate of the city of Rome

questions.text: How was Paul allowed to stay when they entered Rome?
questions.explanation: The centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

answers.text: In the barracks with the other prisoners
In the house of the captain of the guard
Free to go wherever he wished
By himself with the soldier who guarded him

questions.text: How long did Paul stay in his own rented house, and what did he do there?
questions.explanation: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house, receiving all who came to him and preaching God's Kingdom with all boldness.

answers.text: Three months, waiting for his trial
Two whole years, preaching God's Kingdom to all who came
Seven days, before sailing on
Forty days, teaching only the leaders of the Jews
